{{Top|leg}}
'''Sith Victory''' was the name of a [[Flower/Legends|flower]] native to the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was valued for its pleasant aroma, which was only released when the flower was handled violently. It did not attract flying insects, but rather those that tread the ground.
